SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ua IS NOT NULL AND (("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5)) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".symptoms IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+')::NUMERIC * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."T-BIL" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "top_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_bilirubin" FROM "eligible") SELECT "e"."T-BIL", "e".date, "e".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "top_bilirubin" AS "t" ON "e"."T-BIL" = "t".max_bilirubin INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 10) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "titers" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT id, rnp_titer FROM "titers" WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM "titers") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 GROUP BY id) AS "platelet_patients" ON "platelet_patients".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') GROUP BY id) AS "rnp_patients" ON "rnp_patients".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".date_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id AS "patient_id", "l".date AS "test_date", "l".dna AS "dna_level", MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id) AS "max_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna NOT ILIKE '%negative%' AND "l".dna NOT ILIKE '%<%') SELECT patient_id, test_date, dna_level FROM "eligible" WHERE dna_level::NUMERIC = max_level ORDER BY patient_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN '-' ELSE '+' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-') AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 16 GROUP BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN '-' ELSE '+' END ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis = 'RA, SJS' OR diagnosis = 'SJS, RA'), "normal_platelet_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "target_patients" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NULL) AS "patients_without_normal_platelet_result" FROM "target_patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "normal_platelet_patients" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "marked" ON "marked".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|, )SLE(,|$)' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG((first_examination_date - first_visit_date)::NUMERIC)) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date" AS "first_visit_date", MIN("x"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination_date" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "x" ON "x".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "x"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patient_delays" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::INTEGER >= 300)) SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "count_difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_creatinine_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "levels" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_level) AS "max_level" FROM "levels") SELECT "levels".id, "levels".anti_rnp_level FROM "levels" INNER JOIN "highest" ON "levels".anti_rnp_level = "highest".max_level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('+2(100)', 'TR')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_date" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "ld".id FROM "latest_date" AS "ld" INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "ls" ON "ls".id = "ld".id WHERE "ld".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "ls".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING BOOL_OR(ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND BOOL_OR("U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0', '%%', 'TR'))) AS "patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::REAL < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."id" = "p"."id" AND "l"."alp" >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative') SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".rnp_value = (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_range_measurements" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".hgb < 10), "maxima" AS (SELECT "e".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "e".id), "overall" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "maxima") SELECT "m".id, "p".sex, "m".highest_rnp FROM "maxima" AS "m" INNER JOIN "overall" AS "o" ON "m".highest_rnp = "o".highest_rnp INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "m".id LIMIT 501

WITH "first_records" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "first_records" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) > 10 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "r".date, "r"."U-PRO" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(gpt) AS "max_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" WHERE gpt < 60 GROUP BY id) AS "normal_tests" ON "normal_tests".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp = '16' OR rnp = '64' OR rnp = '256') AS "rnp_patients" ON "rnp_patients".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(CASE WHEN gpt < 60 THEN 1 END)) AS "all_normal" ON "all_normal".id = "p".id ORDER BY "normal_tests".max_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|, )SLE($|,| )' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) SELECT "e".care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "x".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_anti_rnp_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "x".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "x" ON "x".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".care_setting ORDER BY "e".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "max_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "l".id AND "latest".max_date = "l".date WHERE "l".igg >= 2000) AS "recent" ON "recent".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest_igg" AS (SELECT id, igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s".setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".igg > 900 AND "l".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "l" ON "l".id = "s".id AND "l".rn = 1 GROUP BY "s".setting LIMIT 501

WITH "most_recent" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l"), "qualifying" AS (SELECT id FROM "most_recent" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 32) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "q".id LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".date IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') AS "inpatient_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+(') AS "outpatient_count", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '+(')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "diagnosis" NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "ld" ON "ld".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') GROUP BY id) AS "up" ON "up".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' ORDER BY ("p"."First Date" - "p".birthday) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".diagnosis <> '' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' AND ("e".diagnosis = 'SjS' OR "e".diagnosis LIKE 'SjS,%' OR "e".diagnosis LIKE '%, SjS' OR "e".diagnosis LIKE '%, SjS,%') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm_lab" ON "sm_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "sm_lab".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') GROUP BY "p".id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "e".thrombosis <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rbc_lab" ON "rbc_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("rbc_lab".rbc <= 3.5 OR "rbc_lab".rbc >= 6.0) AND "rnp_lab".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "rnp_lab".rnp <> '0' AND "rnp_lab".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".date < ("p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years')::DATE AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_without_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' AND "p".element IN ('p', 'br') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'all_single' ELSE 'other' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_groups" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "carcinogenic_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atom_ids" AS (SELECT atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected"), "bonded_element_counts" AS (SELECT "ca".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "ca".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "carcinogenic_atoms" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "bonded_atom_ids" AS "bai" ON "bai".atom_id = "ca".atom_id GROUP BY "ca".element), "max_count" AS (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) AS "max_bonded_atom_count" FROM "bonded_element_counts"), "total_atoms" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_atom_count" FROM "carcinogenic_atoms") SELECT "bec".element, ROUND(100.0 * "bec".bonded_atom_count / "ta".total_atom_count, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_atoms" FROM "bonded_element_counts" AS "bec" CROSS JOIN "max_count" AS "mc" CROSS JOIN "total_atoms" AS "ta" WHERE "bec".bonded_atom_count = "mc".max_bonded_atom_count ORDER BY "bec".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('#', '=')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE ("a".element = 'cl' AND "a2".element <> 'cl') OR ("a2".element = 'cl' AND "a".element <> 'cl') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT neighbor_id) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "neighbor_id", "sulfur".molecule_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id WHERE "sulfur".element = 's' UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id AS "neighbor_id", "sulfur".molecule_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "c".atom_id2 = "sulfur".atom_id WHERE "sulfur".element = 's') AS "neighbors" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "neighbors".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "n" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "disqualified" ON "disqualified".molecule_id = "n".molecule_id WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "disqualified".molecule_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') > 0), "atom_counts" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id GROUP BY "a".molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "carbon_touching" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bonds" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".number_of_atoms, COALESCE("bc".number_of_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_bonds", "ac".carbon_atoms AS "number_of_carbon_atoms", "ac".chlorine_atoms AS "number_of_chlorine_atoms", COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "carbon_touching" AS "ct" ON "ct".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY number_of_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, number_of_atoms, number_of_bonds, number_of_carbon_atoms, number_of_chlorine_atoms, number_of_carbon_touching_bonds, number_of_multiple_bonds FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "ya" ON "ya".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "ya".molecule_id WHERE "ya".element = 'y' AND ("a1".element = 'h' OR "a2".element = 'h') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("atom_bonds".bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "u".element, SUM("u".bond_count) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element UNION ALL SELECT "a1".element AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a1".element) AS "u" GROUP BY "u".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "a".element, "a".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".element, "a".atom_id HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "eligible_atoms" GROUP BY element ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
